api:
<Stat> shows one big number per value: the current CPU, today's revenue, the error count. It can add a sparkline of the history, colour the number or the whole tile, and show the change since the start. It is a port of Grafana's Stat panel; see Coming from Grafana.

Which values are shown

reduce decides how many tiles there are:

Your datareduceTiles
rows with valueReduce::Calc(calc) (default Last)one tile: calc over every row, with a sparkline
rows with value and nameReduce::All { limit }one tile per row, no sparkline
a FrameReduce::Calc(calc)one tile per field, each with its own sparkline
a FrameReduce::All { limit }one tile per cell

Layout

Each tile picks one of Grafana's four layouts from its size:

TileLayout
more than 2.5 times wider than tall, with a sparkline and taller than 50 pxname on the left, value on the right, sparkline in the bottom half
more than 2.5 times wider than tall, otherwisename and value side by side, centred vertically
taller than 100 px, with a sparklinename above value, sparkline filling the rest
otherwisename above value, centred vertically
  • wide_layout={false} always uses the stacked layouts.
  • justify_mode={JustifyMode::Center} centres the text. Tiles without a name are always centred.
  • Text is sized to fit. With several tiles, every tile uses the size that fits the longest name and value, so they line up. title_size, value_size and percent_size fix the sizes instead.
  • text_mode: Auto shows only the value for a single tile and the name and value for several. Name shows the name in place of the value; None shows neither and leaves the colour and sparkline.
  • Several tiles. BarOrientation::Auto packs tiles into the grid that keeps them closest to square. Horizontal stacks them as rows and Vertical places them side by side.

Colour

The value's colour comes from a mapping if one matches, otherwise from color: the threshold step it reaches, its position on a scheme between min and max, a palette colour per tile, or one fixed colour.

color_modeEffect
Valuethe number in the value's colour
Backgroundthe tile filled with a gradient of the value's colour, text in black or white for contrast
BackgroundSolidthe tile filled with the value's colour
Nonethe number in your theme's text colour

The sparkline uses the value's colour, or white on a background. GraphMode::Area fills under the line; Line draws only the line; None hides it.

Percent change

With show_percent_change, each tile reduced from several rows shows the change from the first to the last number, as Grafana computes it: (last - first) / first × 100. An arrow shows the direction.

percent_change_colorColour
Standardgreen when it rises, red when it falls or stays the same
Invertedred when it rises, green when it falls: for errors, latency, cost
SameAsValuethe value's colour

No change is shown when the first number is 0.

examples.title: Single value
examples.description: The last CPU reading, coloured by thresholds, with a sparkline.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn single() {
    let data = use_signal(samples(1));
    rsx! {
        <Stat data={data} value={|s: &Sample| s.cpu} x={|s: &Sample| s.time} reduce={Reduce::Calc(Calc::Last)} thresholds={Thresholds::absolute(&LOAD[..])} format={percent} class="h-40" />
    }
}

examples.title: Horizontal list
examples.description: Three fields stacked as rows, coloured on a scheme.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn list() {
    let data = use_signal(regions());
    rsx! {
        <Stat
            data={data}

            fields={&["eu-west", "us-east", "ap-south"]}
            orientation={BarOrientation::Horizontal}
            color_mode={StatColorMode::Background}
            color={GaugeColor::Scheme(Scheme::GreenYellowRed)}
            min={0.}
            max={100.}
            decimals={0}
            class="h-72"
        />
    }
}

examples.title: Live data
examples.description: A signal as data: value, sparkline and change update.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn live() {
    let round = use_signal(1u64);
    let data = use_signal(samples(1));
    rsx! {
        <div class="flex flex-col gap-2 h-48">
            <div
                id="next"
                class="cursor-pointer text-sm underline"
                onClick={move || {
                    let next = round.get() + 1;
                    round.set(next);
                    data.set(samples(next));
                }}
            >
                "Load the next hour"
            </div>
            <Stat data={data} value={|s: &Sample| s.cpu} x={|s: &Sample| s.time} show_percent_change={true} thresholds={Thresholds::absolute(&LOAD[..])} format={percent} class="flex-1" />
        </div>
    }
}
